title: Полночь в Терновом лесу

words.ex: At midnight Mira left the court.
The forest was silver with moonlight.
Every shadow looked like a monster.
Then Mira heard footsteps behind her.
Between the trees stood a wolf.
Branches hit her face and caught her hair.
words.ex_ru: Ветки хлестали её по лицу и цеплялись за волосы.

words.ex: Her breath was loud in her ears.
words.ex_ru: Её дыхание громко отдавалось в ушах.

words.ex: It chased her deeper into the Thornwood.
words.ex_ru: Он гнал её всё глубже в Терновый лес.

story: At midnight Mira left the court through a small door near the kitchens. The forest was silver with moonlight, and every shadow looked like a monster.
Lirra was not at the old oak. Nobody was.
Then Mira heard footsteps behind her. Slow, heavy footsteps — and they were not human.
She turned. Between the trees stood a wolf, bigger than a horse, with eyes like burning coals. It was made of shadow and smoke.

Branches hit her face and caught her hair. Her breath was loud in her ears. The wolf did not hurry. It was playing with her, the way a cat plays with a mouse. It chased her deeper and deeper into the Thornwood.
She fell over a root and hit the ground hard. The wolf was there, right above her. She could feel its cold breath.
Mira did the only thing she could. She pulled the iron ring from her finger and pushed it into the wolf's open mouth.
The wolf screamed — a terrible, almost human sound — and turned into smoke.
For a long moment Mira lay in the leaves, shaking. Then a hand touched her shoulder, and she screamed too.
“It's me,” Ash said. His face was white in the moonlight. “You went into the forest at midnight. Alone. Are you trying to die before Corin kills you?”
“Lirra serves my brother,” Ash said, and his eyes went dark. “She did not want to help you. She wanted you to escape — straight into the wolf's mouth.”

questions.q: Who was waiting for Mira at the old oak?
What was the wolf made of?
How did Mira stop the wolf?
o: She pushed the iron ring into its mouth
She hit it with a branch

grammar.title: Страдательный залог: was + 3-я форма
grammar.text:
Когда важно не кто сделал, а что с чем-то сделали или из чего оно, используют be + третья форма.

It was made of shadow and smoke — «Он был сделан из тени и дыма».
The debt will be paid — «Долг будет оплачен» (урок 2).

Сравни: She made a bargain — «Она заключила сделку» (кто-то делает) и A bargain was made — «Сделка была заключена» (с ней что-то сделали).

Ещё: the way — «так, как»: the way a cat plays with a mouse — «как кошка играет с мышью».
